versions.changelog:
- Initial release of competitor TikTok content strategy analysis skill.
- Scrapes competitor TikTok profiles and recent videos using apidojo actors on Apify.
- Provides analysis of top-performing videos, post frequency, popular hooks, hashtag strategy, and content mix.
- Offers structured workflow and flexible input parameters (handles, video count, analysis focus).
- Returns ready-to-use competitive insights for social media and content teams.
